name: Landmine Push Press
instructions: Hold the free end of a landmine bar at shoulder height.
Dip at the knees, then drive up, using leg power to press the bar overhead.
Lock out with control at the top.
Lower to the shoulder. The leg drive builds explosive pressing power.
longevityNotes: Pressing keeps shoulders useful, but joint-friendly volume beats grinding maxes. Full range, controlled tempo, and balanced pulling keep the shoulders healthy for decades.
overview: An intermediate barbell press-pattern exercise targeting the front delts. Landmine Push Press builds the upper-body pushing strength used in everything from getting off the floor to overhead reaching.
